question: The only confirmed active volcano located in India, the Barren Island Volcano is located about 138 km north east of _______ in the Andaman Islands.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Port Blair.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__****Port Blair:**

__
 
• It is the **capital** of the Andaman and Nicobar Islands.
 
• The only active volcano in India is the Barren Islands, which is **located north of Port Blair.**
 
• It has seen significant** improvements in Internet Connectivity** with the **Chennai-Andaman & Nicobar Islands (CANI) cable**.
 
• It is the entrance to the pristine islands.
 
• It receives roughly 300 cm of rainfall on average.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__****Diglipur:**

 
• It is the biggest town of north Andaman island.
 
• It has about 40 caves that haven't been fully explored.
 
• The **Saddle Peak National Park** is the reason for its popularity.

**Andaman and Nicobar Islands:**

 
• These islands are situated roughly 1,400 km from the mainland of India.
 
• These islands are **divided by the Andaman Sea** from Thailand and Myanmar.
 
• These serve as **vital maritime zone for India**.
 
• These are the **Arakan Mountains**' underwater extension.
 
• These have **dense tropical rainforests.**

**List of tribes in Andaman and Nicobar Islands:**
